items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And who was the clarinet by that? You said it was Piku then, huh? [INTERVIEWEE] Alphonse Peek Good, yeah. He played with the... Was there another one there? No.

ctx.x: Well, I'll tell you why, you know. We used to have to pass the hat around, you see. Mm-hmm. Pick up tips. And I'd run around with the hat, you know, and come back. And I was so fast, you know, that's when they started to call me a rat. And they started to call me a rat then. From that on, all the musicians, practically every one of them, most of them. Old ones, all of them knowed me about rats.
And who was the clarinet by that? You said it was Piku then, huh?
Alphonse Peek Good, yeah. He played with the... Was there another one there? No.
